name: Zapiski iz Bunkera
source:
«The Bunker Notes» is a psychological drama based on the short story of the same name by film director Kim Sung Chan, adapted into a visual novel. The story begins during a pandemic in which the virus destroys people at a rate never seen before. The main character was one of a few that was ready for such a threat. He managed to lock himself away from the world in an autonomous bunker. But sometimes loneliness can lead to both, salvation and despair. After all, every sound behind the iron door can turn out to be an infected, and every shadow - an enemy, waiting to get rid of an extra mouth.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《地堡笔记》是根据电影导演金成灿的同名短篇小说改编成视觉小说的心理剧。故事开始于一场大流行期间，病毒以前所未有的速度摧毁人类。主角是少数几个准备好应对这种威胁的人之一。他设法将自己锁在一个自治地堡中，与世隔绝。但有时孤独会导致救赎和绝望。毕竟，铁门后面的每一个声音都可能被证明是感染者，而每一个阴影都是敌人，等待着摆脱多余的嘴巴。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811190/]Steam[/url]]
